Topics covered in this PDF

BRL-015 (IT Application in Retail) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Information technology in retail, Merchandise Management System, Point of Sale systems, CRM and social CRM
  • Barcode and RFID, business intelligence, start and end of day, magnetic stripe readers, loyalty management, planogram, store atmosphere, retail analytics

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: attempt all questions, maximum marks 100, coverage all blocks, assignment code BRL-015/TMA/2026-27. Part A: short type questions. Part B: two essay type questions of 15 marks each
  • Questions 5 and 6 carry 3x5 marks, as printed

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
